## Definition of Done — check all that apply

- [ ] Linked issue updated and referenced above
- [ ] Branch follows Git Flow (`feature/…` → `develop`; `hotfix/…` → `main` + `develop`)
- [ ] Code self-reviewed; no debug code or leftover TODOs
- [ ] Tests added / updated and passing
- [ ] CI is green (lint, build, tests, code scanning)
- [ ] Docs updated where behavior changed (README / docs / comments)
- [ ] No secrets, keys, or PII committed; large binaries via LFS only when justified
- [ ] No merge conflicts with the target branch
